extensionDescription.message: Converts recipe quantities to metric, right on the page.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-ons manager.

scaleLabel.description: Label of the scale factor input above a recipe's ingredient list.

scaleReset.description: Button that sets the recipe's scale factor back to 1.

scaleHint.description: Tooltip of the scale factor input, describing what it accepts.

servingsLabel.description: Label of the servings stepper above a recipe's ingredient list.

servingsFewer.description: Tooltip of the button that lowers the number of servings by one.

servingsMore.description: Tooltip of the button that raises the number of servings by one.

popupMetric.description: Popup switch that turns conversion to metric units on or off.

popupDisableSite.description: Popup switch that turns the extension off on the current tab's site, shown with the site's hostname below it.

menuConvertSelection.description: Context menu entry for selected text that converts and scales the selected ingredient lines.
